item.title: ICE Agents to Assist at U.S. Airports as Shutdown Strains TSA Staffing
item.description: As long security lines continue to frustrate travelers during a busy spring travel period, federal officials are preparing to deploy Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents to major airports across the country.

item.title: Polymarket Trader’s Near-Perfect Iran Bets Draw Scrutiny
item.description: A trader on the prediction market platform Polymarket has drawn scrutiny after racking up nearly $1 million in profits since 2024 by consistently betting on geopolitical events, often just hours before they unfolded.

item.title: New Zealand Will Give Cash Payments To Low Income Families Amid Global Fuel Crisis
item.description: Nearly 150,000 low income families in New Zealand will be receiving a weekly cash payment to help them afford gas amid the global fuel crisis caused by the war in Iran.

item.title: NCAA Sues DraftKings Over Use Of March Madness Trademarks
item.description: The National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) filed a complaint in federal court last week in which they’re requesting an emergency restraining order to stop the online sportsbook DraftKings from using registered trademarks connected to March Madness.

item.title: Security Guard Addresses São Paulo Incident Involving Chappell Roan
item.description: A security guard connected to the recent controversy involving Chappell Roan is now speaking publicly, offering his own account after multiple versions of events surfaced.

item.title: The Importance Of Proper Electronic Recycling
item.description: While electronics can be recycled, it can feel difficult to figure out the specifics of how to properly dispose of each individual item, but it’s important that we do.

item.title: Paralympic Medalist Danelle Umstead On Redefining Strength Through Battling MS And Blindness
item.description: “MS has taught me to redefine my strength.” Paralympic Skier and medal winner Danelle Umstead is talking about her life and the challenges she’s overcome to make the most out of the opportunities she’s been given.

item.title: Workout Popularized By Jessica Biel Improves Fitness Faster Than Traditional Exercise, Research Shows
item.description: This kind of exercise was recently popularized in the mainstream by actress Jessica Biel, and now, scientists have backed up how well it actually improves fitness faster than traditional workouts.

item.title: ‘Project Hail Mary’ Strengthens Its Lead as 2026’s Biggest Hit
item.description: Despite a crowded theatrical landscape, Project Hail Mary continues to dominate the box office, holding firm in its second weekend and reinforcing its status as the year’s biggest hit so far.

item.title: Gas Prices Top $4 as Middle East Conflict Disrupts Oil Supply
item.description: Gas prices across the United States have surged past a key threshold, placing renewed financial strain on consumers and adding pressure to the broader economy. On Tuesday, the national average for regular gasoline climbed above $4 per gallon for the first time since August 2022, capping weeks of steady increases tied to escalating tensions in the Middle East.
